tests.name: Criterion 1 offline: 'procesa el caso co-industrias-delta' runs the tools in sequence through the own loop; model only sees paths and masked values
tests.recipe: agent: scratch copy of the repo (rsync without node_modules/.git/out/.qa/.planning, node_modules symlinked); bun -e (cwd = scratch root, so @/ and @tests/ aliases resolve) with crearAgente({ directorio: <scratch>, fetch: crearFetchFalso(<guion>).fetch, fuenteEntorno: { LLM_API_KEY: 'clave-falsa-qa', LOG_LEVEL: 'silent', ...overrides } }); turns via agente.turno({ sesionId, mensaje }); events via @tests/helpers/eventos.helper.ts. No network, no real key. Guion modeled on tests/loop/trazador-agente.test.ts GUION_CASO: tool_calls proveedor_leer_solicitud -> proveedor_mapear_campos -> proveedor_generar_formulario -> proveedor_armar_paquete, then a final text. Capture every provider request body (pedidos).
asserts: events show tool_start/tool_end for the 4 tools in order, then text and turn_end
every request body: model == deepseek-flash, thinking disabled (thinking.type == 'disabled'), no agent framework
no sensitive maestro value of co-industrias-delta appears in any request body or event (PII scan with positive control: values present in out/co-industrias-delta/formulario.*)
out/co-industrias-delta/formulario.* and paquete/ exist in the scratch copy
final reply is plain Spanish text, last paragraph is the server question for a LISTO case

tests.name: Criterion 2: confirmation gate and PRD §11 script (no send without explicit confirmation in the next message)
tests.recipe: agent: scratch copy of the repo (rsync without node_modules/.git/out/.qa/.planning, node_modules symlinked); bun -e (cwd = scratch root, so @/ and @tests/ aliases resolve) with crearAgente({ directorio: <scratch>, fetch: crearFetchFalso(<guion>).fetch, fuenteEntorno: { LLM_API_KEY: 'clave-falsa-qa', LOG_LEVEL: 'silent', ...overrides } }); turns via agente.turno({ sesionId, mensaje }); events via @tests/helpers/eventos.helper.ts. No network, no real key. (a) 'procesa el caso ec-corp-andina. No envíes nada todavía' with a guion where the model also calls proveedor_simular_envio with confirmado:true; (b) turn 1 process ec-corp-andina -> pending; turn 2 'envía' with guion calling simular_envio; (c) turn 3 'envía' again.
asserts: (a) simular_envio blocked: tool result CONFIRMACION_REQUERIDA, no ENVIO-SIMULADO.md written; model-passed confirmado:true alone never suffices

(b) turn 1 ends with confirmation_required and needsConfirmation, last paragraph = server question naming ec-corp-andina and listing the bloqueo by display name ('Certificado de cumplimiento tributario'); turn 2 writes out/ec-corp-andina/ENVIO-SIMULADO.md exactly once and only for that case
(c) a repeated 'envía' without a new pending case does not write a second ENVIO-SIMULADO.md

tests.name: CR-01: doubtful phrases never authorize; explicit confirmations do (plus current WR-01 behavior as evidence)
tests.recipe: bun -e importing the confirmation classifier from src/domain/policies/confirmacion.policy.ts (scratch copy) over a phrase table; plus one end-to-end agent turn for 'y el envío' and 'ok, gracias' with a guion that tries simular_envio
asserts: 'y el envío', 'el envío', 'ok, gracias', 'listo, ya', 'vale, el paquete' -> not a confirmation (otro)
'No envíes nada todavía' -> rechaza
'envía', 'sí', 'confirmo', 'envía ec-corp-andina' -> confirma (for that case)
end to end: doubtful phrases leave simular_envio blocked, no ENVIO-SIMULADO.md
record (no assert) the current class of bare acknowledgements 'ok', 'listo', 'vale', 'claro', 'correcto', 'si todo bien' for H2

tests.name: CR-02: the server question always closes a pending turn; the model's own closing question is stripped
tests.recipe: agent: scratch copy of the repo (rsync without node_modules/.git/out/.qa/.planning, node_modules symlinked); bun -e (cwd = scratch root, so @/ and @tests/ aliases resolve) with crearAgente({ directorio: <scratch>, fetch: crearFetchFalso(<guion>).fetch, fuenteEntorno: { LLM_API_KEY: 'clave-falsa-qa', LOG_LEVEL: 'silent', ...overrides } }); turns via agente.turno({ sesionId, mensaje }); events via @tests/helpers/eventos.helper.ts. No network, no real key. guion: process ec-corp-andina, final model text ends with its own unrelated question ('¿Quieres que revise algo más?'); then 'sí'. Control: same model question with no pending case, then 'sí'. Also record (no assert) the open review finding WR-02: a model line '(¿RIMPE o general?)' inside a requiere_confirmacion note.
asserts: pending case: last paragraph == server question; the model's closing question is gone; no truncated fragment left
'sí' after that reply sends once (it answers the server question)
control without pending: 'sí' does not send (CONFIRMACION_REQUERIDA if the model tries)
record whether a '(¿…?)' note line survives (WR-02 of 02-REVIEW 4c30e81, known open)

tests.name: Criterion 3 / CA5: retries with backoff, fallback model, clear Spanish errors (402 = saldo agotado), history intact; CR-03 truncated step
tests.recipe: agent: scratch copy of the repo (rsync without node_modules/.git/out/.qa/.planning, node_modules symlinked); bun -e (cwd = scratch root, so @/ and @tests/ aliases resolve) with crearAgente({ directorio: <scratch>, fetch: crearFetchFalso(<guion>).fetch, fuenteEntorno: { LLM_API_KEY: 'clave-falsa-qa', LOG_LEVEL: 'silent', ...overrides } }); turns via agente.turno({ sesionId, mensaje }); events via @tests/helpers/eventos.helper.ts. No network, no real key. with esperar injected to record waits and fuenteEntorno LLM_MAX_RETRIES=2 and LLM_FALLBACK_ENABLED with a fallback slot; guiones: 429,503 then ok; network error then fallback ok; timeout; 402; then a normal next message in the same session. CR-03: a step with finish_reason=length and truncated tool arguments, then a next turn.
asserts: 429/503 retried with growing waits, then success; no error event
primary keeps failing -> fallback model answers (event/log shows the fallback model)
402 -> Spanish message containing 'saldo' (agotado), no key echoed; timeout -> clear Spanish message
next message in the same session works and the request history is intact (previous user/assistant/tool messages replayed, no duplicates)
CR-03: no tool executed for the truncated step; every later request body has tool_call arguments that parse as JSON objects ('{}' for the truncated one)

tests.name: Criterion 4a: iteration cap and session token budget end in plain language, not an error
tests.recipe: agent: scratch copy of the repo (rsync without node_modules/.git/out/.qa/.planning, node_modules symlinked); bun -e (cwd = scratch root, so @/ and @tests/ aliases resolve) with crearAgente({ directorio: <scratch>, fetch: crearFetchFalso(<guion>).fetch, fuenteEntorno: { LLM_API_KEY: 'clave-falsa-qa', LOG_LEVEL: 'silent', ...overrides } }); turns via agente.turno({ sesionId, mensaje }); events via @tests/helpers/eventos.helper.ts. No network, no real key. AGENT_MAX_ITERATIONS=3 with a guion that keeps calling tools; AGENT_SESSION_TOKEN_BUDGET small with usage that exceeds it; then 'envía' on the exhausted session (record WR-03 of 02-REVIEW 4c30e81).
asserts: iteration cap: final text in Spanish states what was obtained and what is missing; turn_end without a raw error code to the user
token budget: plain Spanish message asking to open a new session; no provider call after the budget is exhausted
record the reply to 'envía' on the exhausted session (known open WR-03)

tests.recipe: agent: scratch copy of the repo (rsync without node_modules/.git/out/.qa/.planning, node_modules symlinked); bun -e (cwd = scratch root, so @/ and @tests/ aliases resolve) with crearAgente({ directorio: <scratch>, fetch: crearFetchFalso(<guion>).fetch, fuenteEntorno: { LLM_API_KEY: 'clave-falsa-qa', LOG_LEVEL: 'silent', ...overrides } }); turns via agente.turno({ sesionId, mensaje }); events via @tests/helpers/eventos.helper.ts. no simular_envio and no write outside out/<caso>/ happens because of the injection

tests.name: WR-02 (round 1): a confirmation turn cut before the send keeps the case pending
tests.recipe: agent: scratch copy of the repo (rsync without node_modules/.git/out/.qa/.planning, node_modules symlinked); bun -e (cwd = scratch root, so @/ and @tests/ aliases resolve) with crearAgente({ directorio: <scratch>, fetch: crearFetchFalso(<guion>).fetch, fuenteEntorno: { LLM_API_KEY: 'clave-falsa-qa', LOG_LEVEL: 'silent', ...overrides } }); turns via agente.turno({ sesionId, mensaje }); events via @tests/helpers/eventos.helper.ts.
